chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Kufi, from 'Abbas ibn 'Amir, from Rabi' ibn Muhammad al-Musalli, from 'Abdillah ibn Muskān, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will register him among those in 'Illiyin.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Kamil al-Ziyarat, transmitted through the chain of Ibn Qulawayh, establishes the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) as a locus of divine presence, equating the visitor's status with the 'Illiyin. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted not merely as a reward for physical visitation, but as a spiritual elevation to the ranks of the righteous, reflecting the unique ontological status of the Ahl al-Bayt. The mention of 'Illiyin connects the act of Ziyarah to the ultimate success of the faithful in the Hereafter.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 10. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Kūfi, from ‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Rabī’ ibn Muḥammad Al-Musalli, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muskān, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Allāh will register those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) among those (who will be) in ‘Illīyyīn.
